points.label: Responsibility entrusted
points.left: Paul speaks farewell to the Ephesian elders. From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly. sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
points.right: Paul describes departure, completed course, and awaiting crown. For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
